Statement: At primary school I convinced my whole class that I was related to a famous footballer.
I still have my old homework folder with all my assignments from Year 9.
I once had a fight with my brother over a missing packet of biscuits at a family holiday in the Lake District.
I ran a sweet shop from my bedroom in Year 6 until my mum found out and confiscated the stock.
I have been going to the same school dance every year since primary school and always get my school tie on backwards.
I named my first goldfish Gordon Ramsay because it kept spitting its food out.
I have been going to the same family friend's dinner parties every Christmas since I was 8 years old.
I still have my old maths homework from when I was 11 that I never finished because I lost it.
I have a pet hamster named Mr Whiskers who loves to sleep in my backpack.
I knitted a scarf for my brother that ended up being longer than he is tall.
I once left my phone charger in the car at the seaside and spent the whole day without a signal.
I once ate a whole jar of pickled onions for a dare and couldn't taste anything for two days.
I spent an hour trying to fix a faulty blender in my kitchen, but I ended up making a cake instead.
I once had a sleepover at my friend's house and we stayed up all night playing video games.
I once bought a birthday card for my best friend before we even met at school.
I have been having a bad habit of leaving my books open on the bus and getting caught by the driver.
I bought a second-hand bike online without seeing it in person and had to bring it back because it was too small.
My first ever job was dressing up as a giant carrot to hand out leaflets at a supermarket.
I once accidentally superglued my shoes to the floor during a school dance, but nobody noticed until it was too late.
I have been taking the same bus route to school every day since primary school and remember the exact route number.
I once ate cereal with orange juice instead of milk because we'd run out, and I actually liked it.
I used to have a pet cat that I would feed and walk on a leash around the block when I was a kid.
I accidentally ordered the wrong size of clothes online and had to return them to the store.
I sang the national anthem at a rugby match in front of three thousand people when I was eleven.
I once accidentally dyed all my dad's white shirts pink by washing them with a red sock.
I was once mistaken for a celebrity's son at an airport and given free ice cream.
I still have my first bike with all its old mucky wheels and rusty chain.
I have a habit of always eating the same packet of crisps from my favourite takeaway when I'm at the cinema.
I accidentally went to school on a Saturday and didn't realise until I found the gates locked.
My family has a tradition of eating Christmas dinner in fancy dress, and last year I was a lobster.
On a school trip I got separated from the group in a museum and ended up in a staff meeting.
I have never eaten a banana in my life because I can't stand the smell.
My grandad taught me to juggle with satsumas and I can still keep five in the air.
I'm scared of butterflies because one flew into my mouth when I was six.
I once tried to make toast in the microwave and set off every smoke alarm in the house.
I've never seen a single Star Wars film all the way through, even though I own all of them.
I won a regional competition for building the tallest tower out of dry spaghetti and marshmallows.
I have a family friend who always invites me to their summer holiday in Cornwall when I was younger.
I once got lost in the corridors of my school because I was trying to find the library to return a book.
I sleepwalked into the garden once and woke up holding a watering can.
